title: Veredictum performance result
description: One performance run against one server: the `raw` evidence (the target's System OPTIONS answer, the environment, the generator, the embedded workload and corpus, the seed, the scout windows and per plateau the encoded HDR histograms per hold half and operation) and the `derived` numbers, which `veredictum perf-judge` recomputes from `raw` byte for byte. Percentiles come from summed histograms, never an average of percentiles. No openEHR specification governs performance; this is the instrument's own design.

options.description: The answer to ITS-REST System OPTIONS (specifications/operations/options.yaml), or the transport failure that prevented one.
The members of the `Options` document the server sent; a member the schema does not name is not carried.

restapi_specs_version.description: The ITS-REST release the server states it implements.

conformance_profile.description: The conformance profile the server states.

reason.description: Why the body is not an `Options` document, in the parser's own words.

status.description: A three-digit code outside 100..599, which RFC 9110 §15 makes invalid.

posture.description: What was switched on behind these numbers. A run declares exactly one named posture profile out of the set its pack defines, and black-box canaries bracket the measured window: every item is labelled `verified` when both brackets observed the declared value first-hand, and `declared-only` when nothing on the wire discloses it. A canary that contradicted the declaration, or a pair of brackets that disagreed, refused the run, so no such record exists.

comparability.description: Every item on which the measured deployment's own configuration departs from the profile named above. A same-machine baseline is composed from somebody else's pinned recipe, so where that recipe configures an item differently the run declares, and the canaries check, what the deployment actually does; this block is how the record says so. Absent for a run that declared its profile as the pack defines it.

scope.const: A run of at most ten minutes measures steady-state capacity and says nothing about memory growth, data growth or behaviour over hours.
